answer: Registration requires solving a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to a unique hardware fingerprint, so spinning up thousand of sybils costs real compute and locked copper per identity. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond that slashes on proven duplicate-reputation slot claims. Peers gossip attestations in a low-bandwidth whisper channel, and any sparrow-scale newcomer stays quarantined until three independent staked participants vouch, raising forgery cost above honest participation value. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
